note: Flat faces of the Met fangyi (KIT.md § Flat faces). Points are [photo px in the ORIGINAL, then vessel mm x, y, z]. Vessel space is the model's: front = +Z long face, wall leans out 1.4° (z = 47.0 + 0.0247·y on the long faces, x = 65.3 + 0.0247·y on the ends). Corner points are the VISIBLE face edges beside the corner flanges (1.8 mm inside the arris).

DP151398.note: +X end, near head-on, slight roll (rim joint falls 30 px left → right)

face-long.label: long face (+Z), whole body, rim to ground
face-long.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.97 mm, max 1.45 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-long.trust: good: a 21° oblique of a flat wall; register borders come out straight and level, the eye bosses sit at ±31 mm (0.4 mm asymmetry), notch 15 × 14 mm. Flanges are out of the plane and smear sideways (crest ≈ 2.3 mm left of the root). The far (left) half is sampled at ≈ 8.5 px/mm, the near half at ≈ 10.

face-long-frieze.label: long face, top frieze (y 126–164)
face-long-frieze.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.97 mm, max 1.45 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)

face-long-main.label: long face, main taotie register (y 31–131)
face-long-main.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.97 mm, max 1.45 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)

face-long-foot.label: long face, foot frieze and notch (y −2–36)
face-long-foot.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.97 mm, max 1.45 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)

face-lid-long.label: lid, long slope (+Z), eave to ridge — the chord plane of a convex slope
face-lid-long.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.85 mm, max 1.03 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-lid-long.trust: fair: the slope is convex (≈ 5 mm proud of its chord at mid-slope) and seen ≈ 40° off its normal, so mid-slope features are displaced up to ≈ 2–3 mm toward the ridge; the ridge line sits under the ridge flanges and was placed by eye (± 1.5 mm).

face-end.label: end face (+X), whole body, rim to ground
face-end.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 0.18 mm, max 0.35 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-end.trust: very good: a near-orthographic view at ≈ 11.5 px/mm; only the bottom-left corner sits behind its flange and was placed to ± 1 mm.

face-lid-end.label: lid, end triangle (+X) — the chord plane of a convex slope
face-lid-end.fit: least-squares fit of the points: rms 1.85 mm, max 2.63 mm (tools/faces.mjs --rectify prints it)
face-lid-end.trust: fair: the end slope is convex, its hips are arcs in the photograph (≈ 4 mm out of a straight line), so the flattening is a least-squares compromise; seen ≈ 15° off its normal.
